findings.text: reachability confirmed: test_passing_implement_run_without_review_is_refused is collected by pytest and reaches the new refusal at reckon/crew/promotion.py:1991; the merged-head-equivalent gate passed 6 tests.

persistence confirmed: test_reasoned_waiver_promotes_and_records_reason reloads the promoted row through ledger.load in _row at line 134 and observes the reason written into review_waiver by reckon/crew/promotion.py:3445 before ledger.append_run at line 3499.

caller reachability confirmed: this is the only production caller of promotion.complete in the repository, it is inside the changed files and forwards the waiver at line 2925; no production caller outside the changed files bypasses the new guard.

the log says the mutation forced unreviewed false, while the live run declares deletion of the refusal branch; the two are behaviorally equivalent and the log reddens the two guard-sensitive tests for that reason, but the declaration is not repeated verbatim, so reckon/crew/promotion.py:3042 rejects the receipt as unmatched.

commit eb848a59 adds this binary figure, but the run's declared write_paths and orientation_write_paths omit it, so the delivered diff exceeds the exclusive scope even though the plan document embeds the figure.

justifications.durability: tests/test_crew_promotion_requires_review.py:142 and :158 fail when the refusal is bypassed or the reason does not survive a ledger reload, and the independent merged-head-equivalent run passed all 6 tests.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_crew_promotion_requires_review.py:142-225 passes 6/6 at code-and-test state 346b98b6, but negative-control.log:1 does not repeat the run record's declared mutation and the validator at reckon/crew/promotion.py:3042 refuses that receipt.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/promotion.py:2082 resolves the review once and threads it through the existing locked completion flow, while reckon/cli.py:2835 follows the neighboring reasoned-waiver option pattern.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/promotion.py:1982-2000 refuses exactly a passing implement run classified scoring without a parsed review, permits a reasoned waiver, and rejects a waiver when nothing is unreviewed.
justifications.scope_discipline: the four declared commits stay within the listed source, test and plan paths except docs/figures/promotion-refusal-flow/refusal_flow.png, which commit eb848a59 adds outside the run's exclusive write_paths.
